text.en:
Gain <void/>Void Invisibility on Powered Melee Kill. (Longer on Finishers)
Heals for X on Powered Melee Kill. (Stronger on Finishers)

Invisibility Duration (on Finishers):
Minor = 6.8 seconds (9.8)
Elite/Guardian = 9.8 seconds (12.7)
Miniboss = 12.8 seconds (15.8)
Boss = 13.3 seconds

Echo of Persistence increases the <void/>Void Invisibility duration by 41.5%.

Bosses and Vehicles are not finishable.
